blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Feed-forward transformer models have recently achieved strong performance in multi-view 3D reconstruction, but they still rely primarily on appearance-based attention and often struggle in dynamic scenes with weak geometric cues. In this work, we introduce a motion- and gravity-aware framework under the Learning Using Privileged Information (LUPI) paradigm. During training, residual optical flow and gravity direction are provided as privileged signals to guide geometric representation learning; during inference, the model uses standard visual inputs only.
  We integrate these priors into transformer backbones with lightweight architectural changes, preserving feed-forward efficiency. Experiments on standard benchmarks show consistent gains in reconstruction accuracy and robustness, especially in scenes with dynamic objects, ambiguous structure, and challenging camera motion. Our analysis further shows that the optimal injection stage is backbone-dependent: middle-layer integration is generally preferable for VGGT, while late-stage integration is more effective for π3. These results suggest that LUPI offers a practical way to inject motion and physical priors into feed-forward 3D reconstruction without increasing test-time complexity.
blocks.zh:
Feed-forward变压器模型在多视三维重建中最近取得了很强的性能,但它们仍然主要依赖外观上的注意,并经常以微弱的几何提示在动态场景中挣扎. 在这项工作中,我们在 " 利用保密信息学习 " 范式下引入了运动和重力意识框架。 在训练期间,提供剩余光学流和重力方向作为特权信号来指导几何表达学习;在推论期间,模型只使用标准视觉输入.
我们把这些前科整合到 具有轻量级建筑变化的变压器骨干中, 保持了进取效率。 关于标准基准的实验显示,在重建的准确性和稳健性方面,特别是在具有动态物体、模糊结构以及具有挑战性的相机运动的场景方面,不断提高。 我们的分析进一步表明,最佳注射阶段依赖骨干:对于VGGT来说,中层集成一般比较可取,而后期集成则比较有效. 这些结果表明,LUPI提供了一个实用的方法,在不增加试验时间复杂性的情况下,将运动和物理前科注入向导3D重建.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Feedforward transformer-based approaches have recently achieved impressive progress in multi-view 3D reconstruction by directly reasoning over dense patch correspondences across images. Methods such as VGGT [ 1 ] demonstrate that strong geometric priors can emerge from large-scale training, enabling accurate reconstruction without computationally expensive Bundle Adjustment [ 2 ] involved in Structure-from-Motion [ 3 ] and dense matching with cost volumes in the Multi-view stereo methods [ 4 ] . This paradigm has significantly improved efficiency and scalability, making feedforward reconstruction an increasingly attractive solution for real-world perception tasks.
blocks.zh: 以FeedForward变压器为基础的方法,最近通过直接推导跨图像的密集补丁对应,在多视图3D重建方面取得了令人印象深刻的进展. VGGT[1]等方法表明,从大规模训练中可以出现强几何前兆,在不计算昂贵的Bundle调整[2]参与结构-从运动[3]和多视立体方法中与成本量密集匹配[4]的情况下,能够进行准确重建. 这种范式大大提高了效率和可扩展性,使饲料重建成为对现实世界感知任务越来越有吸引力的解决办法.

blocks.en: Despite these advances, most existing feedforward models rely primarily on appearance-driven attention mechanisms and treat each input view as a collection of static visual tokens. In practice, however, real-world scenes are rarely static: independently moving objects, camera ego-motion, and temporal inconsistencies introduce challenges that cannot always be resolved from appearance alone. Without explicit motion reasoning, the model must implicitly infer whether observed changes arise from viewpoint variation or true scene dynamics, which can lead to unstable correspondences and degraded reconstruction quality in dynamic or ambiguous scenarios.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进步,但大多数现有的feedforward模型主要依靠外观驱动的注意机制,并将每个输入视图视为静态视觉符号的集合. 然而在实践中,现实世界的场景很少是静态的:独立移动的物体,相机的自我-运动,以及时间上的不一致,都带来了挑战,而光靠外观并不总是能够解决. 没有明确的运动推理,模型必须隐含地推断所观察到的变化是来自观点的变异还是真实的场景动态,这可能导致动态或模棱两可的情景中不稳定的函证和退化的重建质量.

blocks.en: In addition, feedforward reconstruction methods typically operate without global physical orientation cues. As a result, the predicted geometry may suffer from scale ambiguity, drifting orientation, or inconsistent spatial layouts across views, especially when visual evidence is weak or repetitive. Incorporating simple physical priors, such as gravity direction, offers a natural way to stabilize spatial reasoning and enforce a consistent reference frame, complementing purely appearance-based token interactions.
blocks.zh: 此外,向前进的重建方法通常没有全球物理导向提示。 因此,预测的几何可能因尺度模糊,漂移方向,或不同观点的空间布局不一致而受到影响,特别是在视觉证据薄弱或重复时. 纳入简单的物理前兆,如重力方向,为稳定空间推理和执行一致的参考框架提供了自然途径,补充了纯粹基于外观的符号相互作用.

blocks.en: Motivated by the importance of motion and orientation cues in robust visual understanding, we propose to augment 3D vision foundation models with explicit motion- and gravity-aware signals. Specifically, we inject optical flow as an additional motion representation that highlights local pixel displacement patterns, enabling the model to better separate static background structure from dynamic foreground regions. Furthermore, we incorporate gravity direction as a lightweight global orientation prior, providing a stable reference axis that improves spatial consistency across views. These cues introduce structured inductive biases that are absent in standard feedforward architectures, while preserving the simplicity and efficiency of transformer-based reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 由于运动和定向提示在强烈的视觉理解中的重要性,我们提议用明确的运动和重力意识信号来增强3D视觉基础模型。 具体地说,我们注入光学流作为额外的运动表现,突出局部像素转移模式,使模型能够更好地将静态背景结构与动态前景区域分开. 此外,我们把重力方向作为轻量级全球方向纳入前列,提供一个稳定的参考轴,改善各种观点的空间一致性。 这些提示引入了标准馈赠式建筑中不存在的结构化导引偏差,同时保持了基于变压器的重建的简单化和效率.

blocks.en: To maintain architectural integrity and isolate the impact of our priors, we adopt the Learning Using Privileged Information (LUPI) paradigm during fine-tuning and treat the new modalities as privileged data. We demonstrate generalizability by applying this approach to two architectures with distinct structural designs. Comprehensive evaluations on standard benchmarks reveal consistent gains in reconstruction accuracy and robustness, especially in scenarios with dynamic content, complex camera motion, and scale ambiguity. These results indicate that explicitly incorporating motion and physical orientation cues is a robust and generalizable strategy for enhancing feed-forward 3D reconstruction. • We propose a motion- and gravity-aware augmentation for feedforward transformer-based 3D reconstruction, improving robustness in dynamic scenes. • We introduce optical flow as an explicit motion cue for static–dynamic separation, and gravity direction as a global orientation prior for spatial consistency. • We demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach through extensive experiments and ablation studies on standard multi-view reconstruction benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 为了维护建筑完整性和孤立我们前科的影响,我们在微调过程中采用了“利用保密信息学习”的范式,并将新模式视为特权数据。 我们通过将这种方法应用于结构设计截然不同的两种结构,表现出了普遍性。 对标准基准的全面评价显示,在重建的准确性和稳健性方面,特别是在具有动态内容、复杂的相机运动和规模模糊性的情景中,不断提高。 这些结果表明,明确纳入运动和物理定向提示是加强三维重建的有力和普遍战略。 我们建议进行运动和重力意识增强,以进行以3D为基础的变压器重建,提高动态场景的稳健性。 我们引入光学流作为静态-动力分离的明显运动提示,重力方向作为空间一致性的全球方向。 我们通过对标准多观点重建基准的广泛实验和消减研究,证明了拟议办法的有效性。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Feed-forward 3D reconstruction
blocks.zh: 2.1 供餐前三维重建

blocks.en: Recent years have witnessed rapid progress in feed-forward 3D reconstruction, where models directly infer geometry from one or multiple images without test-time optimization. Early learning-based MVS systems [ 5 ] [ 6 ] [ 7 ] [ 8 ] [ 9 ] typically relied on explicit cost-volume construction and geometric reasoning, while more recent foundation-style approaches shift the emphasis toward correspondence learning with large-capacity backbones and transformers [ 10 ] [ 11 ] [ 12 ] [ 13 ] [ 14 ] . In particular, transformer-based feed-forward methods such as VGGT [ 1 ] represent scenes as collections of image patch tokens and perform cross-view reasoning through attention, achieving strong reconstruction quality and scalability. Along this line, π 3 \pi^{3} [ 13 ] further explores efficient multi-view reasoning and generalization under diverse camera configurations, while mapping-oriented systems such as MapAnything [ 14 ] aim to produce geometry or map representations at scale from in-the-wild imagery, emphasizing robustness and transfer. In parallel, large-scale monocular depth pretraining (e.g., DepthAnything v3 [ 15 ] ) provides strong single-view geometric priors that can serve as initialization or auxiliary supervision for multi-view reconstruction and downstream 3D perception tasks. Beyond these examples, related feed-forward reconstruction and correspondence-centric paradigms include DUSt3R/MASt3R-style models [ 11 ] [ 16 ] [ 17 ] that unify matching and geometry prediction in a single forward pass, as well as other transformer-based MVS variants [ 10 ] [ 18 ] that replace hand-crafted matching pipelines [ 4 ] with learned token interactions.
blocks.zh: 近年来,在向导3D重建方面出现了快速进展,模型直接从一个或多个图像中推断几何,而没有测试时间优化. 早期基于学习的MVS系统[5][6][7][8][9] 通常依赖明确的成本量构建和几何推理,而更近一些的基础式方法则将重点转向与大容量骨干和变压器的函授学习[10][11][12][13][14]. 特别是,VGGT[1]等变压器的向导方法代表场景作为图像补丁符号的集合,并通过关注来进行交叉视图推理,实现强大的重建质量和可扩展性. 沿着这条线,π 3\pi^{3}[13] 进一步探索在多样相机配置下高效的多视图推理和概括,而像 MapAnything [14] 这样的面向地图的系统则旨在从浑浑浑的图像中产生几何或地图的表示,强调强性和传导性. 同时,大规模单面深度预训(例如DepthAnything v3 [15])提供强单景几何前缀,可作为多景重建及下游3D感知任务的初始化或辅助监督. 除了这些例子外,相关的Feed-forward重建以及以对应为中心的范式包括DUST3R/MAST3R风格的模型[11][16][17]在单个前传中统一匹配和几何预测,以及其它基于变压器的MVS变体[10][18],用学习到的符号相互作用来取代手工匹配管道[4].

blocks.en: Despite their success, existing feed-forward methods primarily rely on appearance-driven features and implicit geometric regularities learned from data. They generally lack explicit physical or motion priors—such as structured optical-flow cues to disentangle dynamic foregrounds or gravity direction (e.g., from IMU or geo-calibration) to serve as a global orientation reference. Consequently, these models must infer correspondences and spatial consistency purely from visual tokens, which can be brittle in dynamic scenes or under ambiguous textures [ 19 ] . Our work complements this paradigm by injecting lightweight motion and gravity signals into feed-forward transformers, improving geometric robustness while preserving the efficiency of the inference process.
blocks.zh: 尽管它们取得了成功,但现有的向导方法主要依靠外观驱动特征和从数据中吸取的隐含几何规律. 它们一般缺乏明显的物理或运动前兆——例如结构化的光学流提示,以分散动态前景或重力方向(例如来自IMU或地理校准),作为全球方向的参考。 因此,这些模型必须纯粹从视觉符号中推断出函证和空间一致性,这些符号在动态场景中或模糊的纹理下可能很模糊 [19] 。 我们的工作补充了这一范例,将轻量级运动和重力信号注入向前进的变压器,提高几何强度,同时保持推论过程的效率。

blocks.en: 2.2 Learning Using Privileged Information (LUPI)
blocks.zh: 2.2 利用保密信息学习

blocks.en: Classical supervised learning minimizes a loss function L ⁡ ( h ⁡ ( x i , θ ) , y i ) L(h(x_{i},\theta),y_{i}) over training pairs ( x i , y i ) (x_{i},y_{i}) , where the input space X X remains identical during both training and inference. In contrast, Vapnik [ 20 ] introduced the LUPI paradigm to mimic human learning, where a ”teacher” provides supplemental guidance—such as explanations or comparisons—available only during training. This transforms the training set into triplets ( x i , x i ∗ , y i ) (x_{i},x^{*}_{i},y_{i}) , where x i ∗ ∈ X ∗ x^{*}_{i}\in X^{*} represents privileged information that is withheld during inference.
blocks.zh: 古典监督学习将损失函数最小化LQ(h (x ii,θi),y ii)L(h(x_{i},\theta),y_{i}在训练对(x ii,y ii},y_{i}),其中输入空间XX在训练与推论期间始终相同. 与此相反,Vapnik[20]引入了LUPI范式来模仿人类的学习,在这种范式中,“教师”提供补充性指导——例如解释或比较——只在培训期间提供。 这使得训练的设置变成了三胞胎(xi, xi *, yi) (x_{i}, x^{*}_{i}, y_{i}),其中xi * * * * * x^{*}_{i}\in QQ 代表在推论中不公开的特权信息。

blocks.en: While early LUPI research focused on Support Vector Machines (SVMs) to predict slack variables and accelerate convergence [ 21 ] [ 22 ] , the framework has since evolved into a generalized mechanism for knowledge transfer [ 23 ] . LUPI has been successfully applied to diverse domains including image matting [ 24 ] , person re-identification [ 25 ] , and healthcare analytics [ 26 ] . In this work, we integrate the LUPI paradigm with transformer-based 3D foundation models, utilizing motion and orientation priors as privileged information to guide the model toward a more robust, geometrically-aware interpretation of visual inputs.
blocks.zh: 虽然早期的LUPI研究侧重于支持矢量机(SVMs),以预测松懈的变量并加速趋同[21][22],但自此框架发展成为知识转让的普遍机制[23]. LUPI已成功应用于各种领域,包括图像配制[24]、个人重新识别[25]和保健分析[26]。 在这项工作中,我们把LUPI范式与基于变压器的3D基础模型结合起来,利用运动和定向前导作为特权信息,引导模型向更强健,几何感知的视觉输入解析方向发展.

blocks.en: 3.1 Data Preprocessing
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据处理

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Optical flow estimation and decomposition
blocks.zh: 3.1.1 光学流估计和分解

blocks.en: We perform a preprocessing step to selectively compute the residual optical flow for the training data. For datasets composed of continuous video sequences, optical flow can generally be estimated between adjacent frames. However, when large temporal gaps or abrupt scene changes occur, flow estimation becomes unreliable. To address this issue, we first compute an image similarity score between neighboring frames and only estimate optical flow when the similarity exceeds a predefined threshold.
blocks.zh: 我们采取预处理步骤,有选择地计算培训数据的剩余光学流量。 对于由连续视频序列组成的数据集,光学流一般可以在相邻帧之间估算. 然而,当出现大的时间间隔或场景突变时,流量估计会变得不可靠. 为了解决这个问题,我们首先计算相邻帧之间的图像相似度得分,并且只有在相似度超过预定阈值时才会估计光学流.

We assume that the rigid motion induced by camera movement can be approximated by a global affine transformation, which is denoted by 𝐟 i = A ​ 𝐩 i + 𝐭 \mathbf{f}_{i}=A\mathbf{p}_{i}+\mathbf{t} (1) where 𝐟 i \mathbf{f}_{i} is the optical flow of a pixel i i . 𝐩 i \mathbf{p}_{i} is the [ u , v ] [u,v] coordinate of the pixel. blocks.en: Importantly, residual flow does not solely correspond to independently moving objects. The affine transformation provides only a global approximation of camera-induced motion and therefore cannot perfectly model perspective projection effects in scenes with significant depth variation. In regions with large depth gradients, structural discontinuities, or partial occlusions, the global motion model becomes insufficient even under predominantly static conditions. Consequently, these regions yield non-negligible residual flow. Such areas typically coincide with geometrically challenging regions for multi-view aggregation, as illustrated by the traffic light region in Fig. 1 . Therefore, residual flow can also be interpreted as a signal highlighting deviations from the global motion model, which often require more careful geometric reasoning during reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 重要的是,剩余流并不仅仅对应独立移动的物体。 芳香变换仅提供了相机引起的运动的全球近似,因此无法在深度差异较大的场景中完美模拟视角投影效果. 在深度梯度大,结构不连续,或部分闭塞的地区,即使主要是静态条件下,全球运动模型也变得不足. 因此,这些区域产生了不可忽略的剩余流量。 这些地区通常与多景聚合的几何挑战区域相吻合,如Fig的交通灯区所示。 1 (英语). 因此,剩余流也可以被解释为显示偏离全球运动模型的信号,这在重建过程中往往需要更加仔细的几何推理.

blocks.en: 3.1.2 Gravity direction estimation
blocks.zh: 3.1.2 重力方向估计

blocks.en: We estimate 3D gravity vectors in the camera coordinate system for all training images using the pretrained GeoCalib model [ 28 ] . The model is applied offline to each image to extract its corresponding gravity direction.
blocks.zh: 我们估计所有训练图像的相机坐标系统中的三维重力矢量,使用预先训练过的GeoCalib模型[28]. 该模型被离线应用到每个图像上,以提取其相应的重力方向.

blocks.en: GeoCalib first predicts a dense perspective field from a single image, which encodes geometric cues such as vanishing directions and horizon structure. Based on this representation, gravity direction is recovered through a Levenberg–Marquardt optimization procedure. To ensure reliability, we retain only those gravity estimates for which the optimization converges within a predefined number of iterations. In practice, non-convergence occurs only in a very small fraction of images. Samples for which the optimization fails to converge are excluded from gravity supervision. The resulting gravity vectors, expressed in the camera coordinate system, are used as orientation priors during training.
blocks.zh: GeoCalib首先从单一图像中预测一个密集的视角场,它编码几何提示,如消失的方向和视野结构. 基于这种表示,重力方向通过Levenberg–Marquardt优化程序得到恢复. 为了保证可靠性,我们只保留那些在预先确定的重复数内实现优化的重力估计。 在实践中,非趋同只在极少数图像中出现. 优化未能汇合的样本被排除在重力监督之外。 由此产生的重力矢量在相机坐标系统中表示,在训练中用作方向前导.

blocks.en: 3.2 Privileged Information Injection
blocks.zh: 3.2 保密信息注射

blocks.en: To incorporate additional geometric cues during training, we introduce a privileged information injection mechanism that integrates residual optical flow and gravity direction into the transformer-based reconstruction backbone. These signals are encoded into token-aligned representations and injected into the aggregation process with minimal modification to the original architecture.
blocks.zh: 为了在培训期间纳入更多的几何提示,我们采用了一种特权信息注入机制,将剩余光学流和重力方向纳入以变压器为基础的重建主干线。 这些信号被编码成符号对齐的表达式,并注入聚合过程,对原始架构进行最小的修改.

blocks.en: The resulting 5-dimensional vector is passed through a three-layer MLP, referred to as the patch encoder , to produce a residual-flow embedding with the same dimensionality as the visual patch tokens extracted by the DINO backbone. The encoded residual-flow feature is then scaled by a learnable weight W flow W_{\text{flow}} and added to the corresponding patch token:
blocks.zh: 由此产生的5维矢量通过一个称为补丁编码器的三层MLP传递,生成一个与DINO骨干提取的视觉补丁符号具有同等维度的剩余流嵌入. 编码的剩余流特性随后被可学习的重量W 流WQQText{flow}缩放,并添加到相应的补丁符中:

blocks.en: t ~ p ​ a ​ t ​ c ​ h = t p ​ a ​ t ​ c ​ h + W flow ⋅ f f ​ l ​ o ​ w . \tilde{t}_{patch}=t_{patch}+W_{\text{flow}}\cdot f_{flow}. (2)
blocks.zh: t ~ p a t c h = t → t c h + W 流 → f f l o w. \ tilde{t}_{patch}=t_{patch}+W_{\text{flow}}\cdot f_{flow}. (2)

blocks.en: This additive fusion allows motion information to be integrated with minimal perturbation to the existing embedding space while enabling the network to leverage dynamic cues during multi-view aggregation.
blocks.zh: 这种添加剂聚变使运动信息能够与现有的嵌入空间进行最小的扰动整合,同时使网络能够在多视图聚合时利用动态提示.

blocks.en: In addition to motion cues, we incorporate scene orientation information through gravity direction. The gravity vector is first normalized and then encoded using a two-layer MLP, referred to as the gravity encoder , producing a representation aligned with the dimensionality of camera tokens. The encoded gravity feature is scaled by a learnable parameter W grav W_{\text{grav}} and fused with the camera token:
blocks.zh: 除了运动提示之外,我们通过重力方向整合场景导向信息. 引力矢量首先正常化,然后使用双层MLP编码,称为重力编码器,产生与相机符的维度一致的表示. 由可学习参数W grav WQQQText{grav} 缩放编码的重力特性,并与相机符号结合:

blocks.en: t ~ c ​ a ​ m = t c ​ a ​ m + W grav ⋅ f g ​ r ​ a ​ v . \tilde{t}_{cam}=t_{cam}+W_{\text{grav}}\cdot f_{grav}. (3)

The specific implementation of this fusion varies depending on the model architecture. For π 3 \pi^{3} , since there are no specialized camera tokens, we define the camera tokens as the aggregator encoder’s output embeddings that feed into the camera head. The gravity feature corresponding to a specific image is fused with all constituent patch tokens for the image.
blocks.zh: 这种聚变的具体实施取决于模型架构的不同. 因为没有专门的相机标志, 我们定义相机标志为聚合编码器输出嵌入相机头。 与特定图像相对应的重力特性与图像的所有组成补丁符号结合。

blocks.en: For VGGT, we modify the gravity input to align with its reference-frame design. The first camera token in the sequence receives no gravity information, as it serves as a fixed reference for camera parameters. All subsequent tokens are fused with a concatenated gravity vector containing both their own view’s orientation and that of the first view. This ensures the gravity features remain aware of the reference frame with minimal learning overhead.
blocks.zh: 对于VGGT,我们修改重力输入,以便与其参考框架设计保持一致. 序列中的第一个相机符号没有收到重力信息,因为它作为相机参数的固定参考. 所有后来的标志都与含自身视野和第一视野方向的凸轮重力矢量结合。 这确保了重力特征始终了解参考框架,学习间接费用极少。

blocks.en: This design allows the model to incorporate global orientation priors that help stabilize camera estimation and improve geometric consistency across views.
blocks.zh: 这一设计使模型能够纳入有助于稳定相机估计和提高各种观点的几何一致性的全球方向前期。

blocks.en: The encoded privileged information can be injected at different stages of the transformer-based aggregation module, as illustrated in Fig. 2 . Specifically, residual flow features are fused with patch tokens, while gravity embeddings are combined with camera tokens when such tokens are present.
blocks.zh: 如Fig所示,编码的特权信息可以在基于变压器的聚合模块的不同阶段注入. 2. 具体地说,剩余流体特征与补丁符号结合,而重力嵌入则与出现这种符号时的相机符号结合.

blocks.en: For reconstruction architectures that do not explicitly maintain camera tokens (e.g., π 3 \pi^{3} ), gravity embeddings are instead injected before the camera decoder to influence the camera prediction stage.
blocks.zh: 对于没有明确维护相机信号符的重建架构(如π 3\pi^{3}),重力嵌入则在相机解码器之前注射,以影响相机预测阶段.

blocks.en: The framework supports multiple potential injection points throughout the aggregator layers, as shown in Fig. 2 . Empirically, our experiments show that the optimal injection position depends on the backbone architecture, with different models favoring different stages of the aggregator.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,该框架支持整个聚合层的多个潜在注入点。 从经验来看,我们的实验表明,最佳注射位置取决于骨干结构,不同的模型倾向于集合器的不同阶段.

blocks.en: 3.3 Finetuning
blocks.zh: 3.3 微调

blocks.en: Our training objectives include local and global point maps, log-space depth maps, pixel ray directions, and pairwise camera translations and rotations. Additionally, for synthetic datasets, we incorporate surface normal and depth-gradient signals to provide finer geometric supervision. All loss terms are computed using the Generalized Robust Loss [ 29 ] , with the final objective being a weighted sum of these individual components. We provide detailed formulae and hyperparameter configurations in the supplementary materials.
blocks.zh: 我们的培训目标包括局部和全球点图、日志-空间深度图、像素射线方向和对等相机翻译和旋转。 此外,对于合成数据集,我们纳入表面正常和深度梯度信号,以提供更细的几何监督。 所有损失条件均使用一般强力损失[29]计算,最终目标是这些个别组成部分的加权总和。 我们在补充材料中提供了详细的公式和超参数配置。

blocks.en: Following the principles of Learning Using Privileged Information (LUPI), we employ a two-stage finetuning strategy designed to extract reliable privileged features and subsequently train the model to interpret and hallucinate them during inference.
blocks.zh: 按照 " 利用保密信息学习 " (LUPI)的原则,我们采用两阶段的微调战略,旨在提取可靠的特权特征,并随后培训模型在推论期间对其进行解释和幻觉。

blocks.en: The primary objective of the first stage is to develop a robust privileged information encoder and adapt the model’s decoders to utilize it. We freeze the model layers preceding the information injection point, focusing training exclusively on the privileged encoder (i.e. residual flow or gravity encoder) and the downstream decoder layers. This isolation ensures the new modality encoder receives sufficient gradient signal to provide meaningful features while the decoders learn to leverage this injected information. By freezing the early encoder layers, the privileged features are forced to align with the existing distribution of patch and camera tokens, facilitating better fusion. To minimize architectural disturbance, we also freeze unrelated decoders and heads; for instance, the VGGT camera decoder remains frozen in stage 1 when finetuning with residual flow as the privileged modality.
blocks.zh: 第一阶段的主要目标是开发一个强大的特权信息编码器,并调整模型的解码器加以利用。 我们冻结了信息注入点之前的模型层,将训练完全集中在特权编码器(即残余流或重力编码器)和下游解码器层. 这种隔离可确保新模式编码器获得足够的梯度信号,以提供有意义的特性,而解码器则学习利用这种注入的信息. 通过冻结早期的编码器层,特权特征被迫与现有的补丁和相机符号的分布一致,有利于更好的聚变. 为了尽量减少建筑扰动,我们还冻结了无关的解码器和头;例如,VGGT相机解码器在以剩余流作为特权方式进行微调时仍然冻结在第一阶段.

blocks.en: As privileged modalities are unavailable at inference time under the LUPI paradigm, the second stage shifts toward guiding the primary model to converge faster and learn more robustly. With the privileged encoder and decoders now prepared, we unfreeze the entire model and introduce aggressive modality dropout. This mechanism creates a shortcut for the finetuning process, forcing the unfrozen model encoder to ”hallucinate” the missing privileged features when they are dropped out. In this framework, the privileged information encoder acts as a teacher during standard iterations, while the model encoder serves as the student during dropout iterations. The student learns to extract high-level features related to motion or gravity cues directly from visual inputs, effectively filling the gap left by the privileged modality to maintain the performance gains established in stage 1.
blocks.zh: 由于在LUPI范式下,在推论时无法获得特权模式,第二阶段转向指导初级模式更快地汇合起来,更有力地学习。 有了特制的编码器和解码器 我们解冻了整个模型 并引入了积极的模式退出。 这种机制为微调过程创造了捷径,迫使解冻模型编码器在被丢弃时“吸入”缺失的特权特征。 在此框架内,特权信息编码器在标准迭代期间担任教师,而模式编码器在辍学迭代期间担任学生。 学生学习直接从视觉输入中提取与运动或引力提示相关的高水平特征,有效填补特权模式留下的空白,以保持第1阶段确定的性能收益.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集

blocks.en:
We apply dataset-level train-test split using 13 high-quality datsets. Among them, 11 are used for training and 2 are used for benchmarking. For our LUPI method, gravity vectors are pre-computed for all datasets, while dynamic flow maps are computed for 6 of them where continuous scene frames are available.
A wide range of indoor and outdoor scenes are covered in the datasets either synthetic or captured in the wild. In each training epoch, we randomly sampled a fixed number of scenes from each training dataset: 1,000 in Spring, 2,750 in UnrealStereo4K, and 26,250 in the other 9 datasets. We preprocess the datasets into WAI format [ 14 ] for the ease of training and benchmarking.
blocks.zh:
我们使用13个高品质的datset来应用数据集级列车测试分解. 其中,11项用于培训,2项用于制定基准。 对于我们的LUPI方法,所有数据集的引力矢量都是预先计算出来的,而对于其中6个有连续场景帧的,则计算出动态流图.
数据集中覆盖了广泛的室内和室外场景,要么是合成的,要么是在野外捕捉的. 在每个训练时代,我们从每个训练数据集随机抽取了固定数量的场景:春季1000场,不真实Stereo4K场2,750场,其他9个数据集26,250场. 我们预先将数据集处理成WAI格式[14],以便于培训和制定基准。

blocks.en: 4.2 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.2 执行细节

blocks.en: We implement our method using the official pretrained checkpoints of π 3 \pi^{3} [ 13 ] and VGGT [ 1 ] , fine-tuning them with the proposed motion and orientation priors. The injection points for privileged information are tailored to each architecture: for VGGT, information is injected into the 12th layer of the aggregator. In contrast, as π 3 \pi^{3} lacks explicit camera tokens, we inject additional modalities after the aggregator but before the specific transformer decoders to maintain architectural isolation. Specifically, gravity features are injected before the camera decoder, while residual flow features are integrated before the point and confidence decoders. A detailed analysis of these injection points is provided in Section 4.4 .
blocks.zh: 我们采用经过预先训练的正式检查站(3\pi^{3}[13]和VGGT[1])的方法,根据提议的动议和方针前科加以调整。 特权信息的注入点是针对每个架构的:对于VGGT,信息被注入集合器的第12层. 反之,由于\\ 3\ pi\ 3} 缺乏明显的相机标志, 我们在集合器之后, 在特定的变压器解码器之前, 注入额外的模式来维持建筑隔离。 具体来说,重力特性在相机解码器之前注入,而残余流特性则在点和置信解码器之前融合. 第4.4节详细分析了这些注射点。

blocks.en: All models are fine-tuned for a total of 10 epochs. For single-modality configurations, Stage 1 (Privileged Alignment) spans the first 2 epochs, while the remaining 8 epochs are dedicated to Stage 2 (Knowledge Distillation). During Stage 2, we employ a scene-wise modality dropout rate fixed at 0.5 to encourage the model encoder to hallucinate privileged features. To ensure stable gradient flow to the privileged encoders, the scaling weights W flow W_{\text{flow}} and W grav W_{\text{grav}} are initialized and fixed at 1.0 during the first two epochs.
blocks.zh: 所有型号均经过精细调整,共计10个纪元. 对于单一模式配置,第一阶段(优先对齐)跨越前两个纪元,其余8个纪元则专门用于第二阶段(知识扭曲). 在第二阶段中,我们采用了一个场景模式的辍学率固定在0.5,以鼓励模型编码器产生特殊特征的幻觉。 为了确保向特权编码器稳定的梯度流,在前两个纪元中,缩放权重W流WQQText{flow}}}和WgravWQQQText{grav}}}被初始化并固定为1.0.

blocks.en: For experiments involving both modalities, we utilize a sequential multi-stage fine-tuning schedule. The model first undergoes Stages 1 and 2 for optical flow injection during the initial 5 epochs. In the subsequent 5 epochs (Stages 3 and 4), we introduce gravity injection using the same two-stage protocol while maintaining the presence of the flow injection. This sequential curriculum allows the model to stabilize one privileged modality before integrating the second, ensuring coherent multi-modal feature fusion.
blocks.zh: 对于涉及两种模式的实验,我们采用顺序式多阶段微调时间表。 该型号在最初的5个纪元中首先经过第1阶段和第2阶段的光学流注入. 在随后的5个纪元(阶段3和4)中,我们采用相同的两阶段协议引入重力注射,同时保持流注入的存在. 这一顺序课程使该模式在整合第二种模式之前能够稳定一种特权模式,确保连贯一致的多模式特征组合。

blocks.en: 4.3 Dense Multi-View Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 多维评价

blocks.en: We evaluate our method under the dense multi-view protocol using both π 3 \pi^{3} and VGGT backbones. Figures 3 and 4 report performance across a varying number of input views.
blocks.zh: 我们利用 3\ 3\ 3} 和 VGGT 的主干线来评估我们的方法。 图3和图4汇报了不同方面的意见。

blocks.en: On both architectures, injecting residual flow consistently outperforms the baselines across all key metrics, including depth relative error, ray alignment, and inlier-based statistics. These gains confirm that explicitly modeling dynamic motion is highly beneficial for feed-forward multi-view reconstruction. Similarly, the introduction of gravity priors yields results comparable to residual flow, further validating the role of global orientation cues in enhancing structural alignment. Crucially, models fine-tuned with both modalities outperform those using any single injection, demonstrating that these priors are complementary rather than redundant or contradictory.
blocks.zh: 在这两个结构中,注射残余流动始终超过所有关键指标的基线,包括深度相对误差、射线对齐和基于更强值的统计数据。 这些成果证实,明确建立动态运动模型,非常有利于多景重建。 同样,采用重力前置法产生的结果与剩余流量相当,进一步证实了全球定向提示在加强结构协调方面的作用。 关键的是,两种模式的微调都超过了使用任何单一注射方式的模型,表明这些前科是互补的而不是多余的或相互矛盾的。

blocks.en: Notably, the performance gap between our method and the baseline widens as the number of input views increases. In dense settings, cross-view aggregation becomes the dominant factor, which simultaneously amplifies geometric inconsistencies caused by independently moving objects or misaligned camera orientations. By effectively suppressing these inconsistencies, motion and gravity awareness leads to increasingly pronounced gains as view redundancy grows. This trend indicates that our approach actively enhances cross-view geometric aggregation rather than merely compensating for sparse observations.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,我们的方法与基线之间的性能差距随着投入意见数量的增加而扩大。 在稠密的设置中,交叉视图聚合成为主导因素,同时放大了独立移动对象或相机方向错位导致的几何不一致. 通过有效抑制这些不一致之处,运动和重力意识导致视线冗余增加而日益显眼。 这一趋势表明,我们的做法积极加强交叉视野几何汇总,而不是仅仅补偿稀少的观察。

blocks.en: Furthermore, the consistency of these improvements across both π 3 \pi^{3} and VGGT demonstrates that our proposed learning framework generalizes effectively across different feed-forward reconstruction backbones without requiring specialized architectural modifications.
blocks.zh: 此外,这些改进在3\pi^{3}和VGGT之间的一致性表明,我们拟议的学习框架有效地概括了不同的向导重建主干线,而不需要专门的建筑改造。

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.4 阅读研究

blocks.en: 4.4.1 Residual vs. Full Flow Injection
blocks.zh: 4.4.1 残留与全流注入

blocks.en: To examine the necessity of motion decomposition, we conduct experiments by injecting both full optical flow and residual flow into VGGT and π 3 \pi^{3} . Table 2 reports the reconstruction performance of each variant under the 8-view setting.
blocks.zh: 为了检查运动分解的必要性,我们进行实验,将全光学流和剩余流注入VGGT和  3\pi^{3}。 表2在8视图下报告每个变体的重建绩效。

blocks.en: Empirically, injecting full optical flow yields performance comparable to the baseline, with slight degradation observed in some metrics. In contrast, injecting residual flow consistently achieves the best performance across both backbones.
blocks.zh: 经验是,注射全光学流产生与基线相当的性能,在某些度量中观察到轻微降解。 与此相对照,注射残余流动在两个骨干部门都取得了最佳业绩。

blocks.en: A possible explanation is that full optical flow contains both camera-induced rigid motion and dynamic motion. But with the random set of views sampling for 3D vision models’ input, there is no guarantee of the sequence of the view nor the existance of the next view whose camera relate to the source view in the way expressed by rigid motion. In contrast, By explicitly removing the rigid component, residual flow isolates motion signals that deviate from the global motion due to the camera. These signals often correspond to independently moving objects or geometrically challenging regions, making them more readily helpful for 3D reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 一个可能的解释是,全光学流既包含相机引起的刚性运动,也包含动态运动. 但是,随着三维视觉模型输入的随机一组观点取样,其相机以刚性运动表达的方式与源视图相关的下一个观点的顺序和存在性都得不到保证. 相比之下,通过明确去除刚性元件,剩余流将运动信号隔离出由于相机而偏离全球运动的信号. 这些信号往往对应独立移动的物体或几何挑战的区域,使得它们更容易帮助3D重建.

blocks.en: 4.4.2 Layer-wise Injection Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.4.2 逐层注入分析

blocks.en: To determine the optimal depth for incorporating motion and orientation priors, we evaluate feature injection at three distinct stages of the reconstruction backbone: Early (input image patch features), Middle (intermediate aggregator layers), and Late (aggregator output). Performance benchmarks for 8-view scenes are summarized in Table 3 . Our results reveal a consistent architectural preference: middle-layer injection performs best on most metrics for VGGT, while late-layer injection is optimal for π 3 \pi^{3} .
blocks.zh: 为了确定纳入运动和定向前题的最佳深度,我们评价在重建骨干的三个不同阶段的特征注入: 早期(输入图像补丁特性),中间(中间聚合层),和晚期(聚合输出). 表3概述了8景的绩效基准。 我们的结果显示建筑上的偏好:中层注射在VGGT的多数度量上表现最好,而后层注射则对 \ 3\ pi\ 3} 最为理想。

blocks.en: At this depth, patch and camera tokens have developed sufficient global geometric awareness to fuse effectively with privileged features. Unlike late injection, this placement allows subsequent transformer blocks to refine the fused representations through cross-view attention, ensuring deeper integration before reaching the decoders. Furthermore, VGGT’s explicit camera tokens provide natural modality isolation: gravity features fused with camera tokens are directed exclusively to the camera head, while residual flow features in patch tokens are reserved for depth-related decoders.
blocks.zh: 在这个深度,补丁和相机符号已经形成了足够的全球几何意识,可以有效地与特殊特征结合。 与晚期注射不同,这种放置允许后续的变压器块通过交叉视野注意来细化引信的表示,在到达解码器之前确保更深层次的集成. 此外,VGGT的显式相机符号提供自然模式隔离:装有相机符号的重力特性完全对准相机头,而补丁符号中的剩余流动特性则保留给与深度相关的解码器.

blocks.en: The absence of explicit camera tokens in π 3 \pi^{3} means the aggregator output is shared across all heads. Middle-layer injection causes privileged information to leak into unrelated decoders (e.g., gravity features influencing the point decoder). Injecting at the aggregator output instead allows for precise, head-specific integration, providing the isolation necessary for superior performance.
blocks.zh: \ 3\ pi\ 3} 中缺少清晰的相机符号, 意味着聚合器输出在所有头之间共享 。 中层注射会导致特权信息泄露到不相关的解码器(如重力特征影响点解码器). 输入聚合器输出则可以进行精确的、针对头的整合,为优异性能提供必要的隔离。

blocks.en: This configuration consistently yields the poorest results across all cases. Raw input features lack the cross-view geometric context required to interpret motion priors. Additionally, this placement forces the pretrained image encoder—which lacks multi-view awareness—to handle the complex task of feature hallucination, a burden that undermines the LUPI learning shortcut and prevents the model from effectively leveraging the privileged information.
blocks.zh: 在所有情况下,这种组合始终产生最贫穷的结果。 原始输入特征缺乏解释运动前缀所需的交叉视图几何上下文. 此外,这种放置迫使预先训练的图像编码器——缺乏多视图意识——处理特征幻觉的复杂任务,这种负担破坏了LUPI学习快捷方式,使模型无法有效地利用特权信息。

blocks.en: 4.4.3 Gravity Prior Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.4.3 重力先导分析

blocks.en: To evaluate the effect of gravity injection, we train two models under identical settings: one with gravity prior and one without it. Figure 5 shows the reconstructed point maps predicted by the two models. The model trained with gravity prior produces more stable global structures, where ground surfaces appear flatter and walls are more consistently aligned with the vertical direction.
blocks.zh: 为了评价重力注射的效果,我们在相同的环境下训练两种型号:一种是重力前置型,一种是无重力前置型. 图5显示两个模型预测的重建点地图. 之前经过重力训练的模型产生更稳定的全球结构,地面表面看起来是恭维的,墙壁与垂直方向更加一致.

blocks.en: This observation suggests that gravity prior mainly improves reconstruction by enforcing a global orientation reference rather than altering local geometric predictions. By anchoring the reconstruction to a physically meaningful direction, gravity helps reduce structural drift and leads to more geometrically coherent scene reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 这一观察表明,先重力主要通过执行全球方向参照,而不是改变局部几何预测来改善重建. 重力通过将重建固定在一个实际有意义的方向上,有助于减少结构漂移,并导致更几何连贯的场景重建.

blocks.zh: 图5:与不重力注射进行定性比较。 每对中,上部图像显示重建时没有重力注入,下部图像显示重建时有重力注入.

blocks.en: 4.5 Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.5 分析

blocks.en: We discuss the proposed priors from three perspectives: view-density behavior, architecture-dependent injection preference, and prior complementarity.
blocks.zh: 我们从三个角度来讨论拟议前科:视图密度行为,依赖架构的注射偏好,以及之前的互补性.

blocks.en: First, the gain over the baseline increases with the number of input views. This trend indicates that the guidance of motion and gravity priors does not simply compensate for sparse observations; instead, they improve the consistency of cross-view geometric aggregation. As view density grows, dynamic regions introduce stronger multi-view conflicts, and residual flow helps suppress these inconsistencies.
blocks.zh: 首先,比基线的收益随着投入视图的增多而增加。 这一趋势表明,运动和重力前导的引导并不仅仅弥补了少量的观测;相反,它们提高了截面几何聚合的一致性. 随着视图密度的增长,动态区域引入了更强的多视角冲突,剩余流有助于抑制这些不一致.

blocks.en: Second, the optimal injection stage is backbone-dependent. For π 3 \pi^{3} , late-stage injection performs best, suggesting that decoder-side integration better preserves modality isolation when no explicit camera token is available. For VGGT, middle-layer injection is generally more effective, likely because privileged cues can be fused earlier with geometry-aware tokens and further refined by subsequent cross-view transformer blocks. In both backbones, early-stage injection is consistently weaker, implying that shallow appearance-dominant features are less suitable for privileged geometric guidance.
blocks.zh: 第二,最佳注射阶段依赖骨干。 对于 \ 3\ pi\ 3} , 晚期注射效果最好, 表示当没有明显的相机标志时, 解码器- 侧式集成会更好地保存模式隔离 。 对于VGGT来说,中层注射一般效果更好,可能是因为特权的提示可以更早地与几何感知符连接,并由之后的交叉视变压器块进一步精炼. 在两种骨干中,早期的注射一直较弱,这意味着浅显主力特征不太适合特权几何制导.

blocks.en: Third, residual flow and gravity priors contribute at complementary structural scales. Residual flow primarily improves local dynamic consistency by emphasizing non-rigid motion components, while gravity provides a global orientation anchor that stabilizes scene-level structure. Their combination improves geometric coherence without changing the feed-forward inference paradigm.
blocks.zh: 第三,残余流动和重力前兆在结构上起到互补的作用。 残余流主要通过强调非刚性运动元件来提高局部动态一致性,而重力则提供全球方向锚,稳定场景级结构. 它们的结合可以改善几何一致性,而不会改变向导推论的范式.

blocks.en: 5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 限制

blocks.en: A limitation of our current formulation lies in the use of rigid optical flow components. In principle, rigid flow primarily reflects the apparent motion induced by camera ego-motion, implicitly encoding information about the underlying translational velocity and angular velocity of the camera. Such signals can be highly informative for stabilizing geometry and improving motion-aware reasoning.
blocks.zh: 我们目前配方的局限性在于使用刚性光学流动组件。 原则上,刚性流主要反映相机自负-运动引发的明显运动,暗含对相机基本翻译速度和角速度的编码信息. 这种信号对于稳定几何学,改善运动意识推理来说,可以提供大量信息.

blocks.en: However, most existing feedforward multi-view reconstruction frameworks, including VGGT, are designed for static-scene reconstruction and operate on unordered sets of input images, without explicit temporal ordering or timestamp information. Under this setting, the rigid flow component does not provide a consistent notion of camera dynamics across views, and consequently offers limited benefit for reconstruction performance in our experiments.
blocks.zh: 然而,包括VGGT在内的大多数现有的feedforward多视图重建框架都是为了静态场景重建而设计的,并在没有顺序的一组输入图像上运行,没有明确的时间顺序或时间戳信息. 在这种背景下,僵硬的流量部分无法提供不同观点的相机动力学的一致概念,因此对我们的实验中的重建业绩的效益有限。

blocks.en: We believe that the velocity and angular motion cues embedded in rigid flow remain a valuable source of physical information. An important direction for future work is to extend feedforward reconstruction toward streaming or temporally coherent settings, where sequential inputs and ego-motion estimates can be explicitly modeled. Incorporating rigid motion cues in such a framework may further improve robustness and enable more principled dynamic scene reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,嵌入在僵硬流中的速度和角运动提示仍然是物理信息的宝贵来源。 未来工作的一个重要方向是,把重建工作扩大到流畅或时间上一致的环境,从而可以明确模拟连续的投入和自我运动估计。 将僵硬的动向纳入这一框架,可进一步提高稳健性,促进更有原则的现场重建。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we presented a motion- and gravity-aware framework for feed-forward multi-view 3D reconstruction under the Learning Using Privileged Information (LUPI) paradigm. During training, residual flow and gravity cues are used as privileged supervision signals; during inference, the model operates with standard visual inputs only, while retaining the geometric benefits transferred from privileged modalities.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出了一种运动和重力意识框架,用于在“学习使用保密信息”范式下进行多视三维重建。 在训练期间,残余流和引力提示作为特权监督信号;在推论期间,该模型只使用标准视觉输入,同时保留从特权模式转移的几何效益.

blocks.en: Extensive experiments show consistent improvements in reconstruction accuracy and robustness, especially in dynamic scenes, under ambiguous geometry, and across challenging camera motion. The results further indicate that the optimal injection stage is architecture-dependent, highlighting the importance of aligning privileged-feature integration with backbone design.
blocks.zh: 广泛的实验显示重建精度和稳健性持续提高,特别是在动态场景,在模糊的几何学下,以及跨越挑战性的相机运动. 研究结果进一步表明,最佳注射阶段依赖架构,凸显了将特权地貌整合与骨干设计相结合的重要性.

blocks.en: Overall, this study demonstrates that LUPI is an effective and practical mechanism for introducing motion and physical priors into feed-forward 3D reconstruction without sacrificing inference efficiency. We hope this perspective motivates future work on temporally coherent and physically grounded feed-forward reconstruction with richer privileged training signals.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,本研究表明,LUPI是一种有效而实用的机制,在不牺牲推论效率的情况下,将运动和物理前兆引入向导立体重建. 我们希望这一视角能激励今后在时间上一致和基于实际的反馈重建工作,同时发出更丰富的特权培训信号。

blocks.en: Appendix A Finetuning Details
blocks.zh: 附录A 细化细节

blocks.en: We employ the WAI_format [ 14 ] for dataset pre-processing and fine-tuning. Specifically, we determine the co-visibility between all image pairs within a scene by evaluating the re-projection error derived from ground-truth depth maps and camera poses. During fine-tuning, input sequences are curated by sampling images that maintain a co-visibility of at least 25% relative to at least one other view in the sequence; this ensures consistent spatial overlap across the chosen views. For each input sequence, we compute local and global point maps, ray directions and distances, camera translations, and rotations (represented as quaternions), alongside a per-view confidence map.
blocks.zh: 我们使用WAI_format [14]来进行数据集预处理和微调. 具体地说,我们通过评估从地面真实深度图和相机中得出的再投影错误,确定一个场景内所有图像对之间的共视性. 在微调时,输入序列通过采样图像进行整齐,相对于序列中至少一个其他视图保持至少25%的共视性;这确保了所选视图之间一致的空间重叠. 对于每个输入序列,我们计算局部和全局点图,射线方向和距离,相机翻译,和旋转(代表四角),同时计算每个视图的置信度图.

blocks.en: All loss terms are calculated using the robust regression loss [ 29 ] with a shape parameter of 0.5 0.5 and a scaling parameter of 0.25 0.25 to mitigate the influence of outliers. We apply a logarithmic transformation to the ground truth and model outputs for point maps and z z -depth values prior to computing the regression loss on their differences; notably, no loss terms are calculated for ray distances or confidence maps. When high-quality, smooth ground-truth point maps are available, we also integrate normal loss [ 43 ] and gradient matching loss [ 44 ] into our objective function. To account for noise and extreme values inherent in “in-the-wild” real-world datasets, we apply confidence weights to the global point map losses and exclude the top 5% of errors as outliers for local point maps and VGGT depth losses. To align with the reference-view-free architecture of π 3 \pi^{3} , we compute pairwise relative pose losses rather than direct differences between predicted and ground-truth global poses. The same 5% outlier exclusion logic is applied to all three losses for π 3 \pi^{3} .
blocks.zh: 所有损失条款都采用强回归损失[29]计算,形状参数为0.5 0.5,缩放参数为0.25 0.25,以减轻外部的影响。 我们在计算其差异的回归损失之前,先对地面真实性进行对数转换,并对点图和z-z的深度值进行模型输出;值得注意的是,对射线距离或信心图不计算损失条款。 在获得高质量,平滑的地面真点地图时,我们还将正常损失[43]和梯度匹配损失[44]纳入我们的客观功能. 为了说明“万无一失”现实世界数据集所固有的噪音和极端值,我们对全球点图损失采用了置信权重,排除了本地点图和VGGT深度损失的前5%误差。 为了与\\ 3\pi\ 3} 的无参考视图架构保持一致, 我们计算成对相对 构成损失, 而不是预测和地面真实的全球构成之间的直接差异。 5 % 的排除逻辑 适用于所有3 个损失。

blocks.en: We conduct an additional ablation study on dataset scale to demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in addressing data scarcity during fine-tuning. We modulate the effective dataset size by varying the total number of scenes sampled from each dataset per epoch. To ensure a consistent number of training steps for a fair comparison, the number of epochs is adjusted inversely to the sampling rate; for instance, when reducing the number of scenes to 10%, the total training duration is increased from 10 to 100 epochs. Figure 6 illustrates a consistent performance improvement as the effective dataset size increases during π 3 \pi^{3} fine-tuning. However, as shown in Figure 7 , introducing residual flow injection with only 10% of the training data yields higher benchmarking performance than increasing the dataset size tenfold. Similar results for VGGT are shown in Figure 8 .
